g.text: Scope: inference workers + app, adapter, WebSocket, MongoDB, Redis and gateway cgroups; OS and unrecorded processes excluded.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #666666

g.text: Recorded services include concurrent public traffic. Memory is sampled current usage, not a continuous peak. No human-capacity claim.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #666666

g.text: Admission times are not completion times. Whole-turn latency includes queueing and game handling; it is not pure Maia inference time.
